functions.name: build_score_record
functions.description: Build a Lakehouse row for the AiReadiness.Scores table.

functions.name: score_active_relationships
functions.description: Score the ratio of relationships that are marked as Active.

functions.name: score_ai_instructions
functions.description: Score whether the semantic model contains meaningful AI instructions / Notes for AI text.

functions.name: score_auto_summarization
functions.description: Score whether every column has a sensible SummarizeBy configuration.

functions.name: score_bidirectional_relationships
functions.description: Score the ratio of relationships that filter in a single direction only (penalizes bi-directional cross filtering).

functions.name: score_boolean
functions.description: All-or-nothing scorer that awards full points when a flag is true.

functions.name: score_business_friendly_names
functions.description: Score how many object names use business-friendly conventions.

functions.name: score_description_coverage
functions.description: Score description coverage for a list of model objects (tables, columns, or measures).

functions.name: score_facts_dims_identifiable
functions.description: Score whether every table is either a classified fact/dimension or hidden.

functions.name: score_format_strings
functions.description: Score the share of non-hidden measures that have a Format String applied.

functions.name: score_measure_organization
functions.description: Score whether related measures (shared base column or shared base name) live in a single display folder.

functions.name: score_ratio
functions.description: Generic proportional scorer based on matched/total counts.

functions.name: score_relationship_cardinality
functions.description: Score the ratio of relationships that use 1:1 / 1:N / N:1 cardinality (penalizes many-to-many).

functions.name: score_star_schema
functions.description: Score star-schema characteristics using relationship-based fact/dimension classification.

functions.name: score_synonym_coverage
functions.description: Score how many non-hidden objects have at least one synonym defined.

functions.name: score_technical_tables_hidden
functions.description: Score whether tables that look technical/helper are hidden from consumers.

functions.name: score_time_intelligence
functions.description: Score coverage of time-intelligence pattern families (YTD/QTD/MTD, LY/PY, SPLY) in measure expressions.

functions.name: score_unambiguous_filter_paths
functions.description: Detect ambiguous filter paths in the active relationship graph (parallel edges and cycles).

functions.name: score_units_and_formatting
functions.description: Score the combined format-string coverage across visible measures and visible numeric columns.
